arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Kansas advocate Steve Six argued Article III distinguishes appellate and original jurisdiction.
Six claimed Congress lacks power to regulate original jurisdiction exceptions.
Colorado advocate Suthers argued the special master correctly read the fee statute.
Suthers stated Section 1821 of Title 28 is unambiguous.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Kansas seeks expert fees under a specific statute. Colorado argues the Court lacks power to award them in original jurisdiction cases.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Kansas wants the Court to award expert fees under the specific statute.
Colorado wants the Court to deny the fee request based on jurisdictional limits.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Kansas argues the specific statute clearly authorizes the fee award.
Colorado argues Congress cannot regulate the Court's original jurisdiction powers.
